Publication statement: N.Y. [New York] : Published by M. Dripps, 1867.
Shows Lower Manhattan river piers (numbered) and names of their proprietary companies.
Signed in lead-pencil script on verso: Millard Fillmore, at New York Oct. 5, 1868.

The principal map covers New York City (Manhattan) south of 135th Street; the inset covers it from there northward to the Harlem River at Westchester County; also covers Jersey City (N.J.) and adjacent municipalities.
